title: $300M to keep building the financial operating system for global enterprises
summary: Neuberger Berman joins us, bringing our financing capacity to $300 million, and Alex Melikian steps up as President and CFO.
body_markdown:
Two big pieces of news today. Neuberger Berman is backing Jeeves with new funding that brings our financing capacity to $300 million. And Alex Melikian, our CFO since 2022, is stepping up as President and CFO, effective immediately.


If you're new here: Jeeves is the financial operating system for global enterprises, the companies that do business in more than one country. This capital helps us keep growing our corporate card, spend management, and payments platform, which now processes more than $5 billion in annualized volume for thousands of enterprises across 35 countries.


## Why now


It's been a big year: our total platform volume and revenue grew more than 3x year over year. A few numbers that tell the story:


- **$300M** in financing capacity, with Neuberger Berman joining as a new partner
- **$5B+** in annualized volume processed on the platform
- **3x+** growth in total platform volume, year over year
- **$0 to $2B+** in annualized stablecoin-settled activity, in nine months
- **35** countries where our customers operate on Jeeves


This comes on top of the $110 million equity round we announced in September, led by CoinFund with participation from AllianceBernstein, a16z, Coinbase Ventures, CRV, FJ Labs, GIC, Global PayTech Ventures, ParaFi Ventures, Vista, Wintermute Ventures, Y Combinator and others.


## What it means for our customers


We built Jeeves for companies that operate across borders and are tired of stitching together a different bank, card, and payments provider in every market. Together, the $110M equity raise and the $300M of financing let us keep doing what our customers count on us for: saving them time and money, from automating financial workflows with corporate cards to managing corporate treasury with multi-currency balances.


Everything runs on a single piece of infrastructure. Jeeves gives businesses physical and virtual corporate cards, accounts payable and treasury payments, spend management, and agentic workflows, all running on stablecoin rails that settle in minutes instead of days. AI agents handle reconciliation and financial automation, and accounts receivable and other financial workflows run on the same foundation.


Thousands of businesses in technology, mobility, financial services, retail, and e-commerce run their global operations on Jeeves, including industry leaders like BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak, and XP.


"Global enterprises want one platform to hold, move, and manage money in every market they operate in, and a real banking platform has to be able to extend capital to its customers as easily as it automates a workflow," says Alex Melikian, our President and CFO. "Neuberger is one of the most respected specialty finance investors in the world, and their partnership is a strong endorsement of the quality of our platform, the strength of our enterprise customer base, and the discipline with which we have built it."


"Jeeves has built a modern banking platform designed to address the evolving needs of global enterprises underserved by legacy financial infrastructure," says Peter Sterling, Managing Director at Neuberger. "We were impressed by the quality of the platform, the strength of the team and the performance of the business, and we look forward to supporting its continued growth."


## Alex steps up as President and CFO


Alex joined Jeeves as CFO in 2022 and has scaled our finance, capital markets, treasury, and risk teams. Since then he's led more than $500 million in equity and debt financings, set up the funding structures behind the platform's growth, and guided our expansion to providing financial services across 35 markets around the world.


"Alex has been a driving force behind Jeeves' growth since the day he joined and the architect of the balance sheet that makes our platform possible," says Dileep Thazhmon, our Founder and CEO. "He already operates as a partner across every part of the company. Naming him President recognizes that, and gives us the leadership structure to execute on the opportunity in front of us."


Before Jeeves, Alex spent nearly a decade at Payoneer, the global B2B payments platform, where he led finance, corporate strategy, and corporate development, and led the company's 2021 public listing on Nasdaq. He previously held M&A advisory roles at PwC and corporate finance roles at Comcast NBCUniversal. He holds a Master of Accounting and a B.S. in Management in Finance and Business Legal Studies from Tulane University.


## What's next


This capital helps us keep building what our customers rely on: our corporate card, spend management, and payments platform, in every market they operate in.


## Thank you


To our customers, thank you for trusting us with your money across borders. To our team, thank you for the work behind every number above. And to Neuberger Berman and all of our investors, thank you for backing what we're building.
